cases.finding: src/06-java.md:30, :44 (and template.yaml at :962) say JDK 8 + kit (agent + -Djdk.tls.client.protocols=TLSv1.3,TLSv1.2) gives PQ. Observed on Corretto 8u512 (Lambda java8.al2, lambda/java:8.al2023 image, amazoncorretto:8 on ECS): with HttpsURLConnection every handshake fails, PQ and classical, with BCJSSE 'certificate_unknown(46) <- No hostname specified for HTTPS endpoint ID check'. JDK 8's HttpsURLConnection creates the socket without a host name; BCJSSE 1.78+ fails endpoint identification by default then (bc-java issue #1656). Adding -Dorg.bouncycastle.jsse.client.assumeOriginalHostName=true to JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS fixes it (PQ on all targets, case java-lambda-j8-bundled-hostfix). The tab's JDK 8 test used raw SSLSocket, not HttpsURLConnection. JDK 11+ is not affected.

cases.finding: src/06-java.md:30 ('SunJSSE, TLS 1.2 client default'), :376 ('8 defaults clients to TLS 1.2') and :445 state it for JDK 8 generally. Observed: only the Lambda Java 8 runtime sets jdk.tls.client.protocols=TLSv1.2,TLSv1.1,TLSv1 (java8.al2 zip and the lambda/java:8.al2023 image, also under the image's own RIE without LocalStack); a plain Corretto 8u512 (amazoncorretto:8, and /var/lang/bin/java in the Lambda image started directly) offers TLS 1.3 by default (classical P-256 here). BCJSSE honours the same property, so on Lambda the flag is required with the kit; in containers and EC2 with 8u512 it is not (java-fargate-corretto8-agent-noproto is PQ without it). The flag in JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS overrides Lambda's value.

cases.finding: src/06-java.md:30, :44 (and template.yaml at :962) say JDK 8 + kit (agent + -Djdk.tls.client.protocols=TLSv1.3,TLSv1.2) gives PQ. Observed on Corretto 8u512 (Lambda java8.al2, lambda/java:8.al2023 image, amazoncorretto:8 on ECS): with HttpsURLConnection every handshake fails, PQ and classical, with BCJSSE 'certificate_unknown(46) <- No hostname specified for HTTPS endpoint ID check'. JDK 8's HttpsURLConnection creates the socket without a host name; BCJSSE 1.78+ fails endpoint identification by default then (bc-java issue #1656). Adding -Dorg.bouncycastle.jsse.client.assumeOriginalHostName=true to JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS fixes it (PQ on all targets, case java-lambda-j8-bundled-hostfix). The tab's JDK 8 test used raw SSLSocket, not HttpsURLConnection. JDK 11+ is not affected.
